log.long: A short thick section of a young fast-grown oak log, as long as it is wide, split lengthwise exactly through the pith and lying flat. The camera looks straight down at the flat split face: a square, with a few broad straight vertical grain bands, a dark pith line down the centre and a strip of bark along the left and right edges
log.trans: A short thick section of a young fast-grown oak log seen end-on. The camera looks straight at the flat round end-grain face: about twelve broad, clearly separated growth rings around a small pith, a few radial cracks, a ring of bark around the edge
log.exterior: A short thick section of a young oak log, as long as it is wide, standing upright on one flat end

maki.long: A thick futomaki sushi roll cut lengthwise in half through its centre, lying flat. The camera looks straight down at the flat cut face: a long rectangle, standing vertically in the frame, with stripes of fillings running top to bottom, white rice on both sides and dark nori along both long edges
maki.trans: A thick futomaki sushi roll cut crosswise. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: dark nori ring, white rice, colourful fillings in the middle
maki.exterior: A thick futomaki sushi roll standing upright on one cut end

honeycomb.long: A square block of natural honeycomb cut vertically, parallel to the comb cells. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: long narrow straight wax cell tubes running from bottom to top like vertical stripes, golden honey between thin pale wax walls, wax caps along the top and bottom edges. No hexagons are visible on this face
honeycomb.trans: A square block of natural honeycomb cut horizontally, across the cells. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a square of hexagonal wax cells filled with golden honey
honeycomb.exterior: A square block of natural honeycomb, the comb cells running vertically

strata.long: A square block of layered sedimentary sandstone cut vertically. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a square with many thin horizontal wavy layers of sand, rust, cream and grey rock, slightly undulating
strata.trans: A square block of sedimentary sandstone cut horizontally along one bedding layer. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a square of mostly one rock colour with fine grain and a few patches of the neighbouring layers
strata.exterior: A square block of layered sedimentary sandstone with horizontal layers

terrazzo.long: A square block of terrazzo cut vertically. The camera looks straight at the flat polished cut face: a square of coloured marble chips of many sizes set in grey cement
terrazzo.trans: A square block of terrazzo cut horizontally. The camera looks straight at the flat polished cut face: a square of coloured marble chips of many sizes set in grey cement
terrazzo.exterior: A square block of polished terrazzo

cheese.long: A square block of Emmental cheese cut vertically. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a pale yellow square with round holes of various sizes
cheese.trans: A square block of Emmental cheese cut horizontally. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a pale yellow square with round holes of various sizes
cheese.exterior: A square block of Emmental cheese

onion.long: A brown onion cut lengthwise in half from root to tip, lying flat. The camera looks straight down at the flat cut face, root at the bottom and tip at the top: nested curved white layers converging at the root and at the tip, a thin brown skin around the edge
onion.trans: A brown onion cut crosswise through its equator. The camera looks straight down at the flat round cut face: concentric white rings, a thin brown skin around the edge
onion.exterior: A whole brown onion standing upright, root at the bottom

swissroll.long: A thick Swiss roll sponge cake cut lengthwise in half through its centre, lying flat. The camera looks straight down at the flat cut face: a rectangle, standing vertically in the frame, with stripes of cream and sponge running top to bottom
swissroll.trans: A thick Swiss roll sponge cake cut crosswise. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: a spiral of golden sponge and white cream
swissroll.exterior: A thick Swiss roll sponge cake standing upright on one end

egg.long: A hard-boiled egg cut lengthwise in half from tip to tip, lying flat. The camera looks straight down at the flat cut face, the long axis vertical in the frame: white albumen around an oval yellow yolk
egg.trans: A hard-boiled egg cut crosswise through its middle. The camera looks straight down at the flat round cut face: a ring of white albumen around a round yellow yolk
egg.exterior: A whole peeled hard-boiled egg standing upright on its end

cabbage.long: A red cabbage cut in half from top to bottom through the core, lying flat. The camera looks straight down at the flat cut face, the core vertical in the frame: purple and white leaf layers folding around a pale central core
cabbage.trans: A red cabbage cut crosswise through its middle. The camera looks straight down at the flat round cut face: tightly packed purple and white leaf layers swirling around the centre
cabbage.exterior: A whole red cabbage, core at the bottom

carrot.long: A thick carrot cut lengthwise in half through its centre, lying flat. The camera looks straight down at the flat cut face, the carrot vertical in the frame: orange flesh with a paler central core running top to bottom
carrot.trans: A thick carrot cut crosswise. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: an orange outer ring and a paler star-shaped central core
carrot.exterior: A short thick section of carrot standing upright on one cut end

candle.long: A thick round pillar candle made of many horizontal coloured wax layers, cut lengthwise in half through its centre. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a rectangle standing vertically, horizontal bands of coloured wax and the wick running down the centre
candle.trans: A thick round pillar candle made of coloured wax cut crosswise. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: one wax colour with faint concentric pour rings and the wick dot in the centre
candle.exterior: A thick round pillar candle made of many horizontal coloured wax layers, standing upright

bamboo.long: A thick green bamboo stalk segment cut lengthwise in half through its centre, lying flat. The camera looks straight down at the flat cut face, standing vertically in the frame: the hollow interior, a solid node wall across the middle, fibrous pale walls on both sides
bamboo.trans: A thick green bamboo stalk cut crosswise through a node. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: a solid pale fibrous disc with a green outer skin ring
bamboo.exterior: A short thick green bamboo stalk segment standing upright

cinnamonroll.long: A tall cinnamon roll cut vertically in half through its centre. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: layers of soft bread and dark cinnamon swirl stacked side by side, standing upright
cinnamonroll.trans: A cinnamon roll seen from the top after slicing off the top, the flat round cut face: a spiral of soft bread and dark brown cinnamon sugar
cinnamonroll.exterior: A tall cinnamon roll standing upright

gobstopper.long: A large gobstopper jawbreaker candy cut in half through its centre. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: many thin concentric coloured sugar layers around a small white centre
gobstopper.trans: A large gobstopper jawbreaker candy cut in half through its centre. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: many thin concentric coloured sugar layers around a small white centre
gobstopper.exterior: A large round gobstopper jawbreaker candy

golfball.long: A golf ball cut in half through its centre. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: a thin white dimpled cover, a thin mantle layer and a large coloured rubber core
golfball.trans: A golf ball cut in half through its centre. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: a thin white dimpled cover, a thin mantle layer and a large coloured rubber core

geode.long: A round geode rock cut in half through its centre and polished. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a grey rock rind, bands of agate, and sparkling quartz crystals lining a hollow centre
geode.trans: A round geode rock cut in half through its centre and polished. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a grey rock rind, bands of agate, and sparkling quartz crystals lining a hollow centre
geode.exterior: A round rough grey geode rock, uncut

baseball.long: A baseball cut in half through its centre. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: white leather cover with red stitches at the edge, tightly wound grey and white yarn layers, a small cork and rubber centre
baseball.trans: A baseball cut in half through its centre. The camera looks straight at the flat round cut face: white leather cover with red stitches at the edge, tightly wound grey and white yarn layers, a small cork and rubber centre

tiramisu.long: A square block of tiramisu cut vertically. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a square with horizontal layers of coffee-soaked ladyfingers and white mascarpone cream, cocoa powder on top
tiramisu.trans: A square block of tiramisu cut horizontally through a cream layer. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a square of white mascarpone cream with patches of coffee-soaked sponge
tiramisu.exterior: A square block of tiramisu with cocoa powder on top

marble.long: A square block of white Carrara marble cut vertically and polished. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a white square with thin grey veins running diagonally
marble.trans: A square block of white Carrara marble cut horizontally and polished. The camera looks straight at the flat cut face: a white square with thin grey veins
marble.exterior: A square block of white Carrara marble with grey veins

banana.long: A ripe yellow Cavendish banana, peel on, sliced lengthwise exactly through its centre along its whole curved length, lying flat with its curve in the picture plane and its stem at the top. The camera looks straight down at the flat cut face: the curved ivory flesh with the faint darker central band of the locules and a few tiny dark seed specks along it, a thin yellow peel along both curved edges
banana.trans: A ripe yellow Cavendish banana, peel on, sliced crosswise perpendicular to its length with a sharp knife. The camera looks straight down at the flat round cut face, centered and filling the frame: thin yellow peel with a pale inner layer, ivory flesh, and the soft translucent three-lobed locule pattern of a real banana with a few tiny dark seed specks in the centre
banana.exterior: A whole ripe yellow Cavendish banana standing upright on its flower end, stem at the top, its gentle curve seen from the side
